reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, consistent with expectations for a compliant finding; nothing in the record shows a Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, or minimum termination fee provision.
The only 'penalty' reference (§ 27.3) operates in our favour (Customer may terminate without penalty and receive a refund), so it correctly supports the preferred position rather than a deviation.

The § 2.1 USD 2,000,000 take-or-pay exposure is real but is a minimum-volume commitment, not styled or structured as liquidated damages or an early-termination charge; routing it to the MINCOMMIT rule respects the no-double-flagging instruction, and the rationale expressly discloses the exposure so the evidence is not misleading.
Deterministic checks are empty and the rendered paragraphs are unchanged from the originals, as expected for a no-edit compliant finding.
